shot_description: An enormous satellite dish, precarious atop a modest home, pointed upwards, sending -- or receiving -- from the heavens.

shot_description: B-roll footage of the Anchor and Hal walking a tarmac.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_040

shot_description: BLAM. The gun fires. The apple EXPLODES. And John?
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_050

shot_description:
A CLOSE-UP POV: THROUGH A SNIPER’S SCOPE.
The bullseye scans a city street, bouncing between people, locations.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_060

shot_description: It trails between trees on the city street, moving meticulously.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_070

shot_description: The SCOPE keeps moving then suddenly STOPS ABRUPTLY. It darts back, through a crowd of people to a tree.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_080

shot_description:
John goes to his computer. 
Uploads a picture: a small, yellow-breasted bird. 
John hits send then walks back to the kitchen.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_090

shot_description:
John spins from the sink. On his computer, a chat room has appeared filled with FOUR BLUE-HAIRED OLD LADIES. 

Tighter Shots of HELEN and BLUE-HAIRS
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_100

shot_description: John, five-deep in line at a rental car company.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_200

shot_description: Through the windshield, the Rushville water tower comes into view, like some creature on the horizon.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_230

shot_description: High walls topped with barbed wire. John notes the strangeness of what looks to be a fortified compound.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_240

shot_description: And then, in the distance, he sees the glow of lights from the High School Football stadium.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_250

shot_description: It feels like a microcosm of small town life: the field, the BAND, the CHEERLEADERS. It’s also the aftermath of horrific violence. Floodlights render it all oddly aglow.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_260

shot_description: John's rental car pulls up to the gate he passed last night.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_290

shot_description: A large concrete building...no windows or character..save for a massive array of satellite dishes alongside it.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_300

shot_description: Structures and edifices - ten or so armed men and woman
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_310

shot_description: Hal & John hop out if the car, greeted by Kerry, Billy, and Noah.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_320

shot_description: And of course, the ball sales flawlessly through the hole.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_340

shot_description: It's winter now. Snow is coming down as John drives north. He passes the fortified Macon compound, but it's a shell of itself, having been burnt down years ago.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_390

shot_description: The stadium. Snow is falling. A sheriff's car idles out front. Kerry steps out as John arrives.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_400

shot_description: A man sits on a bench, fairly high up in the bleachers. We see John and Carrie making their way up the snowy aisles, climbing toward the man.
scene: BIDDING_101_SHOT_410

shot_description: We drift down to find John, asleep on a mattress, 150 feet above ground on a water tower.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_010

shot_description: He blinks awake. Sits up. Where the hell is he? John looks over the side and sees Hal on a lawn chair below. He suggests they start flying lessons, but John just walks to the ladder and climbs down.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_020

shot_description: A SMALL BIRD appears, manifested from the ring. [Note: This will appear as an absolutely REAL bird, with a slight green hue.] A beat. Both men seem a little shocked.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_040

shot_description: John stares at the bird, almost like he knows it.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_050

shot_description: Hal takes the bird. Examines it. We sense something about it unnerves Hal. A beat.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_060

shot_description: The bird doesn’t disappear. Hal STARES at it. This is weird.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_070

shot_description: Hal just stares from the bird to John. Shakes it off. Hands the bird to John.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_080

shot_description:
John is looking at the bird, almost like it’s a pet itself.
Hal watches. It seems to annoy him.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_090

shot_description: John stands, bird in hand. He struggles to keep it calm -- an extension of his own mind.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_100

shot_description: John slides the bird into his pocket. Behind him in line, a SURLY MAN watches. John gives a small smile.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_110

shot_description: The bird eats airplane pretzels on a table.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_120

shot_description: The TSA Officer stares. Looks at the bird. Then John. He flips it over, revealing a barcode.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_130

shot_description: Hal pauses to watch a HELICOPTER lift off in the distance from the Macon compound. Hal watches until it’s out of view.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_300

shot_description: The goon presses the staple gun to John's temple and twunnnk. The needle probes plunge into his brain.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_400

shot_description: And we HOLD CLOSE ON HIS EYES, which DILATE like the snap zoom of a camera. He’s SEEING something terrible.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_410

shot_description:
Kerry and Hal’s cars roll up. Deep in the
background, we see a GUARD TOWER. An ARMED GUARD approaches.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_420

shot_description: Macon glances toward the guard tower in the distance.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_430

shot_description: BLAM. A shot rings out the second Hal crosses the property line, dropping him instantly and we MATCH CUT to --
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_440

shot_description: Hal walks along a high walkway of a vast, alien prison. He reaches a door.
scene: BIDDING_102_SHOT_540

shot_description: FIND HAL JORDAN in a dark corridor, illuminated only by the GLOW of his LANTERN. He’s in front of a BARRIER.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_010

shot_description: John, scaling the tower’s precarious LADDER.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_020

shot_description: Focused. SWEATY. A man on a mission.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_030

shot_description: John, now perched atop the tower, removing the ham from his sandwich. In front of him is the map of Macon's ranch.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_040

shot_description: The WHIR of a HELICOPTER draws his focus. It’s headed for MACON RANCH, a MILE from where he sits. He lifts the SCOPE.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_050

shot_description: A CLOSE-UP POV: THROUGH THE SNIPER SCOPE
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_060

shot_description: The crosshairs track the chopper, bouncing between PILOT, TAIL NUMBER, and flashes of its ELUSIVE PASSENGER. The helicopter disappears as it LANDS on Macon's ranch.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_070

shot_description: The scope drifts in and out of focus. LAND ON -- MILITIA, headed to the chopper. They disappear between buildings. Crosshairs swim again. FIND --
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_080

shot_description: HOLD ON this pastoral moment, his POV suddenly voyeuristic, when -- WHOOSH. SOMETHING LOWERS, obstructing John’s view.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_090

shot_description: John removes the scope to see -- Hal, returning from space, arm still in a sling... and crotch in John's line of sight.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_100

shot_description: John & Hal talk on the Water Tower
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_110

shot_description: FIND John’s car cruising down Main Street. Hal drives. John’s shotgun.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_160

shot_description: Where a sign on the door reads: Community Only. Hal and John eye it. Hal looks to John, conspiratorial
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_180

shot_description: Macon, addressing the entire town, Kerry behind him. As before -- conversation halts. Hal looks to a confused John.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_190

shot_description: John's car pulls into the empty lot. Hal and John climb out.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_200

shot_description:
-- a WINDOWLESS, CUBIC BEHEMOTH STRUCTURE, aka THE WEENIE. And next to it -- the HELICOPTER, currently empty. A beat.

Then - JOHN EMERGES FROM THE GROUND. He quickly scans the compound. They're in the clear. He makes for the structure.
Pushes on walls. FINDS -- a DOOR. He gestures back to
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_290

shot_description: An aftrshock sends John flying. Windows rattle. Car alarms blare.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_370

shot_description: John, staring out the window as Hal drives. The car slows as they near the slaughterhouse -- a LARGE BRICK BUILDING FLANKED BY EMPTY ANIMAL PENS.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_420

shot_description:
John spots a MANHOLE affixed to the opposite wall. How odd.
And even weirder, out of the manhole emerges ---- a cow with a familiar yellow ear tag. Holy hell. That's no manhole. It's a portal.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_430

shot_description: The cow ambles out. Stares at John and Hal. A PROJECTION APPEARS on its body, mapping out various cuts of meat.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_440

shot_description: Smooth jazz SWELLS. Hal’s GREEN BUBBLE APPEARS around them
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_450

shot_description: An ARRAY OF PERFECT, RAZOR-THIN LASERS descends upon the cow -- UNTHINKABLY FAST -- SLICING -- DICING --
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_460

shot_description: HOLD ON John and Hal as BLOOD ERUPTS onto their protective bubble. It’s quick. And when it’s over --
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_470

shot_description: It's over in seconds, space sterilized, another cow entering.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_480

shot_description: Hal YANKS the wheel, throws open his door... and rolls out of the car in a protective green glow as John BARRELS OFF THE ROAD.
scene: BIDDING_105_SHOT_490

shot_description: THE CAR CAREENS INTO A LIGHTPOST. METAL CRUNCHES. AIRBAGS EXPLODE as we SMASH TO BLACK.

The fires go away. TIME STOPS.

Mark's looking out the upstairs window, dreamily. Out there is the

-- and now he's in the Polaroid, back in the same moment upstairs.
Mark's carrying water through the house very carefully. But someone trips him and it spills across the table. In slow-motion. He's trying to prevent it from hitting the floor.
Mark's using Polaroids to jump from one time-sequence to the other.
